verdict.rationale: Kit advertises 'Audience tagging & segmentation', supports targeting broadcasts by segment or tag IDs, exposes segments through its MCP server, and provides custom fields for profile attributes. However, nothing in the evidence describes how segments are defined (combining attributes, tags, and behavioral events) or confirms they update dynamically as data changes. Missing for 10: documented segment builder criteria covering profile attributes, tags and behavioral events, evidence that segments stay live and auto-update, independent or hands-on corroboration.
